headline: Earnings swing back to profit

kpis.label: EPS
kpis.delta: swung to profit from a loss

summary_short: Renesas Electronics reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ¥62.16, swinging from a ¥111.46 per-share loss a year earlier, and up 65.4% q/q from ¥37.57.
summary_long: EPS of ¥62.16 swung to a profit from a ¥111.46 per-share loss in the year-ago quarter, and rose 65.4% sequentially from ¥37.57 in the prior quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
